scheme_name: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Old Age Pension
other_conditions: Minimum age 60 years for men and 55 years for women
Applicant must have annual income less than ₹75,000 or belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹1,000 per month is deposited directly into the beneficiary’s bank account through DBT mode.
